description: Read the authenticated user's Tineo email forwarding addresses without changing anything. Returns the personal forwarding address when one exists, any other active personal addresses, and the universal trips@tineo.ai address, which works for mail forwarded from the user's primary or registered email. A personal address can also receive mail sent by an assistant or travel provider. If the user has no personal address and wants one, use forwarding_address_create after they ask for it.
name: forwarding_address_get
title: Get Forwarding Address
